mission: Locate and verify the ORIGINAL image or poster published by the SAME source from which the event information was collected.

steps.action: Find original event-specific image on source event page or source official media
Validate image actually depicts this event, is accessible, is permitted for publication and retain source attribution
If original image unavailable after a reasonable source-specific attempt, find licensed official artist, production or venue image relevant to this event
Only when the above fail use verified subcategory default; if absent use category default

never: Never replace a verified original event image with a generic fallback
Never treat a generic image as evidence of an original event image
Never leave a card blank solely because the original source image was unavailable
Never use unrelated artists, productions or venues
